responsibility: Renders the source-location portion of GCC diagnostics: the source lines, carets, underlines, labels, fix-it hints, margins, and optional line numbers that accompany a rich_location. It belongs to the language-independent diagnostics presentation layer and contains the layout logic that converts byte-based source ranges, macro/line-map locations, tabs, multibyte UTF-8 characters, and diagnostic-path events into visually aligned annotated source snippets, including colorized primary/secondary ranges and fix-it insert/delete highlighting.
